issues.sentence: Her work interrogating what 'mechanistic' actually means for explanation methods [paper:W4404784049] and her findings on easy training data for hard tasks [paper:W4401042639] raise questions I find relevant when asking why tokenizer-adapted Kannada models improve on QA but may still fail on culturally grounded prompts [lib:cv].
